koinDialogue: Welcome to budgeting! The golden rule is Division. Before you spend, split your money: Needs, Wants, and Savings. Let's log your basics today to set a baseline.
tasks: Log at least 2 Needs expenses & 1 Wants expense.
Travel to School/Office and record a Transport expense.
End day with Needs <= 50%, Wants <= 30%, and 20% of your budget saved.

koinDialogue: Don't spend all your budget on just one thing! Diversification means spreading your spending across different categories so your lifestyle is balanced safely.
tasks: Log expenses across at least 4 different categories.
Include at least 2 distinct Needs (e.g., Food + Transport).
Ensure no single expense goes over 40% of the day's total spend.
Keep your 50/30/20 split intact: Needs <= 50%, Wants <= 30%, 20% saved.

koinDialogue: Surprise! A wild expense appeared. A good budget has a buffer to absorb shocks. Let's see if you can handle an Unplanned Expense without breaking the 50/30 limits!
tasks: Log 4+ total expenses today.
Log 1 unplanned expense using the 'Other' category.
Finish the day with your 50/30/20 division perfectly intact.

koinDialogue: Have you noticed prices going up? That's Inflation eating your purchasing power! To keep up, your money needs to grow. Allocate some cash into your savings goals today so it outpaces the price hike.
tasks: Log 1 Food & Dining or Transport expense to cover today's rising essentials.
Allocate at least ₱50 to your Emergency Fund or Fun Money goals to outpace inflation.

koinDialogue: Want your money to grow? You must choose: low risk means safe but slow growth; high risk means more upside but you might lose some. Spread your capital across both your safe Emergency Fund and your riskier Fun Money goal.
tasks: Log 2 essential Need (Food & Dining and Transport) to stay covered.
Allocate funds to both a low-risk goal (Emergency Fund) and a high-risk savings target (Fun Money) to balance your capital allocation.

koinDialogue: After taking risks, it's time to Rebalance! A smart saver adjusts constantly so no goal falls too far behind. Open the Allocate to Goals modal and nudge your targets until both progress evenly.
tasks: Log 3 essential expenses (Food & Dining, Transport, and Groceries) before you rebalance.
Allocate funds at least twice and keep the progress of your Emergency Fund and Fun Money within 15% of each other.

koinDialogue: Let's put your money to work! Simple Interest pays you a flat rate on your original savings. Keep your spending strictly to basics today to lock in your principal amount.
tasks: Log at least 1 Needs expense today. No Wants allowed.
Keep total spending under 20% of your weekly budget.
Keep at least 30% of your weekly budget saved.

koinDialogue: Here is the ultimate money hack: Compound Interest! This means earning interest on top of your past interest. It starts slow, but grows like an avalanche!
tasks: Travel to School/Office via commute and log 1 Transport expense.
Keep total daily spend <= 15% of your weekly budget.
Keep at least 30% of your weekly budget saved.

koinDialogue: Head to the Mall! The secret to compound growth is patience and avoiding the temptation to drain your account. Let's practice controlled exposure.
tasks: Visit the Mall and log at least 1 Needs expense (e.g., Groceries).
Log 0 Wants for the entire day.
Keep at least 30% of your weekly budget saved.

koinDialogue: You mastered division, survived inflation, and harnessed compound interest! Finish strong by securing your final savings rate. You are Koin's ultimate Super Saver!
tasks: Reach at least 30% level savings rate.
Log at least 2 expenses while keeping Wants <= 10% of today's spend.
